items.title: Walmart Just Cratered Almost 10% in a Week. This Retail CEO Says the Holidays Will Prove Everyone Wrong.
items.summary: Walmart beat estimates, raised guidance, and still shed nearly 10% of its value in a week. The reason the market sold it off anyway reveals a quiet battle between what Walmart is choosing to become and what investors thought they were paying for.

items.title: Three Cracks in Consumer Spending Reveal Why Walmart Had Its Worst Day Since 2022 Despite an Earnings Beat
items.summary: Walmart beat on revenue and earnings, then watched its stock post the worst single-session drop in three years. The numbers underneath the headline suggest the problem has less to do with Walmart and far more to do with the shoppers keeping it alive.

items.title: Can Walmart's Tap to Pay Push Strengthen Customer Engagement?
items.summary: Walmart rolls out Tap to Pay across U.S. stores and clubs, adding checkout flexibility as digital sales and membership engagement grow.

items.title: Walmart Has Too Many Stores
items.summary: Walmart keeps opening stores while the rest of retail races online, and that gap between strategy and reality may be catching up with the retail giant in ways its same-store sales numbers only hint at.

items.title: Truflation sees July core PCE at 0.2% MoM, says Fed won’t hike this year
items.summary: Investing.com -- Underlying U.S. inflation pressures are set to persist when the Bureau of Economic Analysis releases the July Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index on Wednesday, but not enough to force the Federal Reserve into a rate hike this year, according to Truflation.

items.title: JP Morgan Warns of Fall Sell-Off Potential: 5 Defensive Dividend Stocks to Buy
items.summary: J.P. Morgan's technical team sees deteriorating market internals and a pattern eerily similar to the months before the 1999 tech crash. Five dividend-paying stocks across defensive sectors may offer shelter if the autumn sell-off materializes.

items.title: Gap Inc. taps Walmart alum in ‘fashiontainment’ push
items.summary: Justin Breton is joining the retailer as vice president of development and will report to entertainment chief Pam Kaufman.

items.title: Visa Jumps Toward Record High as Spending Defies Walmart's Warning
items.summary: The payments giant is signaling that transaction activity remains healthier than the retail selloff suggests.
